name: Jal Jeevan Mission
summary: A mission to provide every rural household with a functional household tap connection supplying adequate and safe drinking water in usable quantity on a regular basis.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must live in a rural area.

entitlement_rules.text: Every eligible rural household receives an in-kind functional household tap water connection; there is no cash benefit.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the village level.
